title: Erection
summary: An erection happens when blood fills the spongy tissue of the penis, making it firm. It can come from arousal, but also randomly, and during sleep (morning wood).
key_points: Random and morning erections are normal and a sign of healthy blood flow.
Occasional trouble getting or keeping an erection is common, especially with stress, alcohol or tiredness.
